short_description: ICold, an Elanpro group company, specializes in high-precision cold storage solutions essential for diverse industries. Backed by advanced heat load calculations and globally recognized software,ICold ensures reliable, efficient, and accurate cold storage performance, making it a trusted name in the industry.

Panels

  • Versatile Application: Suitable for small walk-ins to large cold stores.

  • Easy Installation: Pre-fabricated panels for quick on-site assembly.

Doors

  • Safety Release: Can be opened from the inside for safety.
  • View Port: Allows product visibility without opening the door, saving energy.
  • Posi Seal: Ensures perfect alignment and closing.
  • Sweep Gasket: Airtight seal remains flexible at any temperature.
  • Thermal Break: Prevents condensation and ice buil-up
